mentions.name: Determined
mentions.description: Determined is a mostly deterministic (non-AI) code analyzer for Python and JS/HTML, with Go and Rust support added and other languages possible, that gathers facts about a codebase so appropriate context can be provided to AI assistants, with light AI interpretation layered over the collected facts.
mentions.problem: The author's program became so complex that they could no longer get all the appropriate context into an AI to figure out where to go next, so they built a deterministic analyzer to gather that context.
mentions.audience: The author built it to analyze their own complex program when it became impossible to fit enough context into an AI; it is aimed at developers working on large codebases with AI assistance.
mentions.source_excerpt: So I am building Determined, deterministic analyzer for Python and Js/html. I added Go and Rust because I heard they were popular and it can add others as well.
mentions.author: bartleeanderson
